entries.triggerSummary: Scaffold a new Next.js application with authentication, sign-in / sign-up flows, and a protected dashboard route.

subGoalSkeleton.description: Create a new Next.js app with the app router and TypeScript
Add authentication: install and configure an auth provider
dependsOn: Create a new Next.js app with the app router and TypeScript

subGoalSkeleton.description: Add sign-in and sign-up routes that call the auth provider
dependsOn: Add authentication: install and configure an auth provider

subGoalSkeleton.description: Add a protected dashboard route that redirects unauthenticated users
dependsOn: Add sign-in and sign-up routes that call the auth provider

subGoalSkeleton.description: Smoke-test the flow: sign up, sign out, sign in, visit dashboard
dependsOn: Add a protected dashboard route that redirects unauthenticated users

entries.triggerSummary: Scaffold a new TypeScript CLI tool with argument parsing, a single command entry point, and a vitest test setup.

subGoalSkeleton.description: Initialize a TypeScript project (tsconfig, package.json, vitest config)
Add an argument parser (commander or yargs) and a single command
dependsOn: Initialize a TypeScript project (tsconfig, package.json, vitest config)

subGoalSkeleton.description: Write a smoke test that invokes the command with --help
dependsOn: Add an argument parser (commander or yargs) and a single command

subGoalSkeleton.description: Wire the dist binary in package.json bin map
dependsOn: Add an argument parser (commander or yargs) and a single command
